result.title: Compute-Aware Submodular Online Learning in Open Multi-Agent Systems
result.summary: This paper studies policy learning for cooperative task allocation in open multi-agent systems, where submodular utilities model diminishing marginal returns due to overlapping agent contributions. While standard methods evaluate every candidate action to update the policy, this may incur an excessive computational cost online. Hence, we impose a budget on these evaluations and analytically study the effect of query budget on online learning. Our algorithm samples a prescribed number of agent-action pairs and applies inverse-probability weighting to their marginal gains, yielding an unbiased gradient estimate of the expected stage utility for a Kullback-Leibler (KL) mirror-ascent update. We derive a $1/2$-approximate regret bound that elegantly splits into a tracking error between optimal and learned policies, quantified by their KL divergence, and a query-dependent feedback term. Experiments on cooperative information coverage show that our approach retains high performance with significantly less computation online.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究开放多智能体系统中的协作任务分配策略学习：在子模效用下对候选智能体-动作对的评估施加查询预算，通过抽样加逆概率加权得到期望阶段效用的无偏梯度估计并用于 KL mirror-ascent，同时给出随 KL 跟踪误差与查询量分解的 regret 界，实验显示在线计算显著减少而性能基本保持。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「有限评估预算下按边际增益抽样、用逆概率加权保持无偏估计」的做法，可能可供核查用于 LVR 中视觉证据或候选假设的计算受限筛选与动态计算分配，但论文本身不涉及多模态推理或 latent 状态生成。
